rows.why: TIGER lsad=25 (city) stamped "city" but the roster names it "TOWN OF BUCKEYE" — a town. Two Census publications disagree, and that is a FINDING. RESOLVED IN FAVOUR OF THE STAMP, 2026-08-23. Both agree with TIGER LSAD 25. The 2022 Census of Governments name is STALE — Buckeye was a town and became a city, and a roster keyed to 2022 kept the older name. The stamp is correct and nothing is changed.
